properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued June 25 at 10:38AM PDT until June 27 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.areaDesc: Lake Havasu and Fort Mohave; San Bernardino County-Upper Colorado River Valley
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Lake Wind Advisory, south winds 15 to 25 mph with
gusts up to 35 mph expected. For the Wind Advisory, south winds 15
to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph expected.

* WHERE...In Arizona, Lake Havasu and Fort Mohave County. In
California, San Bernardino County-Upper Colorado River Valley
County.

* WHEN...For the Lake Wind Advisory, from 11 AM PDT /11 AM MST/ to 8
PM PDT /8 PM MST/ Friday. For the Wind Advisory, from 11 AM PDT /11
AM MST/ to 11 PM PDT /11 PM MST/ Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
Strong winds and rough waves on area lakes will create hazardous
conditions for small craft.
properties.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

conditions for small craft.

properties.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued June 25 at 10:29AM PDT until June 27 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40 mph for
Stampede Reservoir, Lake Davis, Antelope Lake, and Eagle Lake.

* WHERE...Lassen-Eastern Plumas-Eastern Sierra Counties.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Friday to 11 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Small boats, kayaks and paddle boards will be prone to
capsizing and should remain off lake waters until conditions
improve.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds may subside below criteria early
Saturday morning before increasing again in the afternoon.
properties.instruction:
Check lake conditions before heading out and be prepared for a
sudden increase in winds and wave heights. Consider postponing
boating activities on the lake until a day with less wind.

properties.headline: Wind Advisory issued June 25 at 10:07AM PDT until June 28 at 11:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Extreme Heat Warning San Diego County Deserts,
dangerously hot conditions with temperatures up to 106.
For the Wind Advisory, west winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts 45 to 55
mph expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Deserts.

* WHEN...For the Extreme Heat Warning, until 8 PM PDT this evening.
For the Wind Advisory, from 5 PM Friday to 11 AM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events. Gusty winds will blow around unsecured
objects. Tree limbs could be blown down and a few power outages
may result.
properties.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.
